__comment__: Rig comparison setup, NOT in the manifest (it needs a Hamamatsu camera). One camera, two drivers: HamamatsuNative (ImSwitch2's own DCAM manager) is enabled; HamamatsuMM (Micro-Manager's HamamatsuHam adapter through the bridge) sits under disabledDevices. DCAM allows one open handle per camera, so run one at a time: in the config editor right-click each device card and choose Disable device / Enable device (or move its entry between detectors and disabledDevices by hand), then run tools/compare_cameras.py once per variant and diff the two reports. Set cameraPixelSizeUm to the same measured value on BOTH entries. Set subarray_hsize / subarray_vsize to your sensor if it is not 2048 x 2048. The hub starts MMCore in both variants but loads no device, so DCAM is untouched while the native camera runs.
